The ball is illuminated by a strong light source from the left, casting deep shadows to the right. The white leather cover is scuffed and stained with dirt, showing signs of wear. The characteristic red stitching is visible but partially obscured by grime and shadow. There appears to be black marker writing or a logo on the side of the ball.
